rulings.Case Title: JOSEPH ALEN BANKS JR VS. BART POLICE DEPARTMENT ET AL
rulings.Calendar Matter: Notice Of Motion And Motion For Substitution Of Successor In Interest, Memorandum Of Points And Authorities, Declaration Of Joseph Alen Banks In Support Thereof, Proof Of Service
rulings.Rulings: Matter on calendar for Friday, August 28, 2026, Line 2, JOSEPH BANKS' Motion For Substitution Of Successor In Interest. Non-party Joseph Alen Banks, Sr.'s motion for substitution of successor in interest is CONTINUED TO DECEMBER 2, 2026, AND THE ACTION IS STAYED UNTIL DECEMBER 2, 2026, OR UNTIL FURTHER ORDER OF THE COURT, WHICHEVER COMES FIRST. Movant Banks is not a party to this case, nor is he a licensed attorney representing a party to this case. Even if Movant Banks were the representative of Plaintiff Banks' estate, generally he could not represent himself as representative on behalf of Plaintiff Banks' heirs. (See Estate v. Sanchez, (2023) 95 Cal.App.5th 331, 343-44 ["filing briefs and other pleadings a representative of the estate constitute[s] the unlicensed practice of law, and those pleadings must be stricken."].) Movant Banks has indicated that he has begun the process in probate court to be assigned as the personal representative of the estate of his deceased son, Plaintiff Banks, and that he plans to seek counsel for this action. (Pl.'s Reply at 3:19-22.) The court continues the hearing on this motion to allow time for Movant Banks to secure counsel or otherwise demonstrate he may proceed on the motion. In the meantime and under the circumstances, the court orders the action stayed until 12/2/2026 or until further order of the court, whichever comes first. Defendant BART Police Department is ordered to prepare a proposed order which repeats verbatim the above tentative ruling and email it to contestdept302tr@sftc.org prior to the time set for this hearing.
